note: Bun/npm bumps that policy refuses until the blocker moves. `yolo update bun status|plan|apply` lists them as held and never bumps them. A hold stops releases above `maxMajor`, or above `maxVersion`. Advisory holds (security findings that no bump can fix) stay in advisory-holds.json. Re-check on every bump and remove an entry as soon as its blocker moves; the table in docs/operations/infra/update/BUN.md mirrors this file.

holds.name: undici-types
holds.reason: @types/node 26.6.x depends on undici-types ~8.9.0 (latest 8.11.2): pinned to 8.9.0 so the workspace holds one copy. Moves with @types/node.

holds.name: @aphrody/canvas
holds.reason: first-party package (m3/packages/canvas, 1.0.9-aphrody.2 on the workspace); consumers resolve it through workspace:*, the catalog entry is unused. The registry copy is not a source of truth (publishing is an owner decision).

holds.name: jsdom
holds.reason: jsdom 30 declares undici ^8.10.2 but the root override forces undici ^7.30.0 (miniflare, @ai-sdk/provider-utils, cheerio, shadcn and the Discord libraries need 7), so 30 would run on an unsupported undici. Moves when the undici override can go to 8.

holds.name: msw
holds.reason: msw 3.0.x does not intercept Bun's native fetch: setupServer + listen leaves fetch un-patched (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND on a mocked host; a Patreon client test suite goes from 174 passing to 8 failing, requests reach the real API). The renamed option onUnhandledFrame is the only documented source change, so this is a runtime incompatibility, not a migration step. Re-test on each 3.x release.
